errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {"error":"Comnview isn’t connected in this app. Ask the person to connect it in the app’s settings: it opens comnview.com, where they sign in and allow it. If the app takes a token instead, the person makes one in Profile › Agents on comnview.com and adds it to the app (sent as \"Authorization: Bearer cvk_…\"). Only the person can do this, in their own browser: don’t sign in to comnview.com, open sign-in emails or create tokens for them."}
